margin_ci_critical_value: Student t quantile 0.975 with df = complete worlds - 1 (scipy.stats.t.ppf)
margin_unit: final-cash margin (variant minus parent) in $ per seat-game, averaged over the two seat orders within a world, then over worlds
rule: Declared decision rule for every binary A-vs-B gate (LAND64, surgery, freshen, combo pick-confirm; coordinator 22:10 09-29, locked-specs review): paired-world sign test on sweeps (a sweep = both seat orders won outright, a sweep loss = both lost, any other complete world = split = tie). Only complete, pre-declared banks decide. Any individually tied game -> HOLD (the sweep endpoint is not reinterpreted). ADOPT a change when the variant's one-sided sweep-sign p <= .05 AND its game-point share is not losing (>= .5). NON-INFERIORITY (freshen, surgery+adapt): the parent must NOT beat the variant at one-sided sweep-sign p <= .10, the variant's mean-margin 95% lower bound must be > -$1,500/world, and at least 32 complete worlds x 2 seats.
